title: SSC CGL 2026 - 15,000+ Vacancies Expected, Notification Update & How to Prepare
author: Ash K.
excerpt: SSC CGL 2026 notification is expected in May 2026 for 15,000+ Group B and C posts. Tier 1 exam likely in June-July 2026. Any graduate can apply. Posts include Income Tax Inspector, CBI Sub-Inspector, Auditor, and more.

related_pages.title: Bank PO vs SSC CGL comparison

body: The Staff Selection Commission is expected to release the SSC CGL 2026 notification soon at ssc.gov.in. Originally expected earlier in 2026 31, the notification was delayed due to administrative reasons. Based on the SSC Calendar 2026-27, approximately 15,000-18,000 vacancies are expected for Group B and Group C posts across central government departments.

SSC CGL is India's most popular graduate-level government exam, recruiting for posts like Income Tax Inspector, CBI Sub-Inspector, Assistant Section Officer, Auditor, Excise Inspector, Preventive Officer, and Statistical Investigator. Last year, SSC filled 15,118 vacancies through CGL - a similar or higher count is expected this year.

Eligibility is straightforward - any Bachelor's degree from a recognized university qualifies you to apply. Age limit ranges from 18-32 years depending on the post, with standard relaxation for reserved categories. The application fee is Rs 100 for general/OBC males and free for women and SC/ST/PwD candidates.

The selection process has two tiers. Tier 1 is a qualifying Computer Based Test covering General Intelligence, English, Quantitative Aptitude, and General Awareness. Tier 2 determines your final merit and post allocation. Both are online exams. Start your preparation now - Tier 1 is expected in June-July 2026, giving you 1-2 months from notification.

callout.heading: What to do RIGHT NOW
callout.content: Complete your SSC One-Time Registration (OTR) at ssc.gov.in if you haven't already - OTR is mandatory for all SSC exam applications and takes 15 minutes. Keep your graduation marksheet, Aadhaar, photo, and signature scans ready. Start Tier 1 preparation immediately - General Awareness (current affairs of last 6 months), Quantitative Aptitude (arithmetic at Class 10 level), and Reasoning (puzzles, coding-decoding, series). The notification can drop any day this month.

faqs.question: When will SSC CGL 2026 notification come?
faqs.answer: Expected in May 2026 at ssc.gov.in. The notification was originally scheduled for March 31 but was delayed. As per the latest SSC Calendar 2026-27, the application window and Tier 1 exam dates will be announced with the notification. Keep checking ssc.gov.in daily.

faqs.question: How many vacancies in SSC CGL 2026?
faqs.answer: Approximately 15,000-18,000 vacancies are expected based on previous year trends. Last year had 15,118 vacancies. The exact number will be confirmed in the official notification. Posts span 30+ roles across Income Tax, Customs, CBI, CBDT, CBIC, and other central government departments.

faqs.question: What is the SSC CGL 2026 exam date?
faqs.answer: Tier 1 exam is expected in June-July 2026 as per the SSC Calendar. Tier 2 is expected in September-October 2026. Exact dates will be announced with the notification. The exam is computer-based (online) conducted in multiple shifts across centers nationwide.

faqs.question: Can final year students apply for SSC CGL?
faqs.answer: You must have completed your graduation by the date specified in the notification (usually the closing date of application). Final year students whose results are pending cannot apply. However, if your degree is awarded before the application deadline, you're eligible even if the convocation is pending - the provisional certificate works.
